evidence.title: GitHub - papermark/papermark: Papermark is the open-source DocSend alternative and secure data rooms with built-in analytics and custom domains. · GitHub

name: Papermark
summary: Open-source DocSend alternative: share documents by link with custom domains, branding and built-in view analytics.
description: A self-hosted document-sharing platform and data rooms: upload documents, send secure custom links, add a custom domain and your own branding, and track who viewed what through built-in analytics. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind and shadcn/ui on PostgreSQL through Prisma, with NextAuth, Tinybird analytics, Resend email and Stripe payments; needs Node.js 18.17+, blob storage (AWS S3 or Vercel Blob) and a PostgreSQL database.
contains: shareable document links with custom domains and branding
Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind and shadcn/ui app on PostgreSQL (Prisma)
AGPL-3.0; the ee/ enterprise directories carry a separate commercial license
run locally with npm install, .env, Prisma DB init, then the dev server on localhost:3000
